description: This file defines TypeScript code for JSON Schema normalization and validation using the Zod library. It includes schemas, constants, and functions to process and normalize JSON Schemas for compatibility with various AI providers, focusing on schema transformations, supported formats, and strict mode compliance.

methods.name: applyArrayProperties
methods.description: Copies array-specific JSON Schema properties from source to target object if they are defined.

methods.name: normalizeToolSchema
methods.description: Normalizes a JSON Schema to be compliant with JSON Schema draft 2020-12, including flattening top-level composition keywords, converting array types, stripping unsupported formats, and setting default properties.
